business_problem: It needed to completely transform its data and reporting solution to store extensive and diverse datasets, perform real-time data processing, and deliver diagnostic and prescriptive analytics. It sought an advanced analytics platform that would be cloud-native, user-friendly, secure, and resilient.
solution_summary: Wipro used Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power BI to unify data and reporting on a shared analytics foundation. It needed to completely transform its data and reporting solution to store extensive and diverse datasets, perform real-time data processing, and deliver diagnostic and prescriptive analytics. It sought an advanced analytics platform that would be cloud-native, user-friendly, secure, and resilient. Key implementation elements included Microsoft Fabric unifies data engineering, storage, and analytics on a single managed platform; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Power BI delivers reports and dashboards to business users; Azure Data Lake stores shared enterprise data for analytics and AI workloads. Operational data is ingested from line-of-business systems into the shared data platform, transformed into analytics-ready models, and served to analysts and business users through dashboards and reporting...

data_flow: Operational data is ingested from line-of-business systems into the shared data platform, transformed into analytics-ready models, and served to analysts and business users through dashboards and reporting experiences.
business_outcome: More scalability, security, and added layers of intelligence Wipro evaluated several products on parameters such as scale, performance, integration with existing applications, and security.
